answer: Trust-flow ranking: each epoch, 100 seed agents push trust along signed paid-job edges, and an ID's reward weight is capped by the max flow it can receive. A sybil island of 1,000 fakes joins the honest reef only through the few real jobs it buys, so its total flow equals those attack edges, not its size. At ~$20 per genuine job edge, each extra weighted fake costs $20 more, linear in fakes; a cluster with no real edges stays frozen tundra with zero flow.
